signed_qr.method: Real issuance/revocation/verification API with temporary SQLite and keys; 12 expiry cases use a clock advanced by two hours.
signed_qr.rate_limits: Unmodified; ten TestClient identities from documentation-only address range 192.0.2.0/24.

latency.method: Sequential successful signed verification API calls via TestClient; includes ASGI middleware and SQLite, excludes real network/browser/TLS/production load.

unsigned_url_policy.network_mock_scope: DNS answers and HEAD/TLS outcomes are controlled fixtures. URL parsing, public-IP filtering, redirect policy, and warning classification execute real analyzer code. No external network request.

definitions.risk_detected: Expected scenario signal appears in reason or signals; installation-file cases are warnings, not blocked.
definitions.benign_risk_flag: Blocked verdict or a specific listed risk signal. The required unsigned_qr and official_domain_unverified warnings are excluded.
definitions.limits: This measures synthetic policy branches, not malicious-URL detection accuracy or production false positives. All benign unsigned URLs remain warnings and never become trusted.

target_comparison.signed_qr_correctness: 100 synthetic API cases cover 50 normal, 25 tampered, and 25 expired/revoked QRs.
target_comparison.verification_time: Local p95 can be compared to the one-second goal only as a local API benchmark; real browser/network/scan latency remains unmeasured.
target_comparison.dangerous_url_detection_95_percent: Not established. Synthetic expected-policy-signal coverage is not accuracy on independently labeled malicious URLs.
target_comparison.false_positive_below_5_percent: Not established. Benign unsigned warning rate is deliberately 100%; the narrower specific-risk-flag metric cannot replace the planned production false-positive target.

privacy: Only aggregate counts, timing, and environment are saved. Temporary keys, tokens, QR payloads, destinations, and database files are discarded.
